forms.pokedex: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.

level_up.name: Multi-Attack
level_up.description: Cloaking itself in high energy, the user slams into the target. This move's type depends on the held memory.

level_up.name: Explosion
level_up.description: The user explodes to inflict damage on those around it. The user faints upon using this move.

level_up.name: Thunder Fang
level_up.description: The user bites with electrified fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.

level_up.name: Ice Fang
level_up.description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.

level_up.name: Fire Fang
level_up.description: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it burned.

level_up.name: Poison Fang
level_up.description: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. It may also leave the target badly poisoned.

level_up.name: Imprison
level_up.description: If the foe knows any move also known by the user, the foe is prevented from using it.

level_up.name: Iron Head
level_up.description: The foe slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.

level_up.name: Tackle
level_up.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

level_up.name: Bite
level_up.description: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. It may make the target flinch.

level_up.name: Aerial Ace
level_up.description: The user confounds the foe with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

level_up.name: Scary Face
level_up.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly reduce its Speed stat.

level_up.name: Double Hit
level_up.description: The user slams the target with a long tail, vines, or tentacle. The target is hit twice in a row.

level_up.name: Metal Sound
level_up.description: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly reduces the target's Sp. Def stat.

level_up.name: Crush Claw
level_up.description: The user slashes the target with hard and sharp claws. It may also lower the target's Defense.

level_up.name: Air Slash
level_up.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may also make the target flinch.

level_up.name: Tri Attack
level_up.description: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. May also paralyze, burn, or freeze the target.

level_up.name: X-Scissor
level_up.description: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

level_up.name: Crunch
level_up.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.

level_up.name: Take Down
level_up.description: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the foe. It also damages the user a little.

level_up.name: Double-Edge
level_up.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle. It also damages the user by a fairly large amount, however.

level_up.name: Parting Shot
level_up.description: With a parting threat, the user lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats. Then it switches out.
